articles.summary: Extreme Networks, Inc . (Nasdaq: EXTR), a leader in AI-powered automation for networking, today announced plans to release financial results for its first fiscal quarter 2027, ended September 30, 2026. The company will announce before market open on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, followed by an earnings conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m. ET. The details for the webcast are: When: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET (5:00 a.m. PT) Where: https://investor.extremenetworks.com Dial in/ webcast: To access the call by phone or webcast, please go to this link ( Registration Link ) and you will be provided with dial-in details. To avoid delays, we encourage participants to dial into the conference call fifteen minutes ahead of the scheduled start time.
